events.title: Pebble Beach Motoring Classic — arrivals
events.summary: Concours-bound classics finish a multi-day tour into Pebble Beach — early week free viewing.
events.description: The Motoring Classic brings entrants over public roads before Concours Sunday. Spectators can often catch cars and crews as they arrive. Treat times as approximate; follow the official event calendar for the 2026 route and any public viewing notes.
whatToLookFor: Rare coachbuilt shapes before the fairway polish

events.title: Monterey Car Week opens
events.summary: Ten days of shows, auctions, races, and roadside moments begin across Monterey County.
events.description: Use Friday to settle logistics: parking plans, credentials, and which free roadside days you will prioritize (especially Tour Thursday). Many hotel and club meets start this weekend. Cross-check See Monterey’s day-by-day list for satellite events.

events.title: Weekend satellite meets & displays
events.summary: Clubs, brands, and local hosts fill Saturday with smaller shows and parking-lot culture.
events.description: Saturday is often heavy with marque clubs and informal gatherings. Schedules shift year to year — use this as a planning placeholder and open the official day list for exact addresses. Great day for free photography without Concours crowds.

events.title: Sunday shows & peninsula cruising
events.summary: More public-facing displays and scenic drives as visitors settle in for the core week.
events.description: Expect continued satellite activity and traffic on 17-Mile Drive approaches. Confirm any ticketed Sunday events (reunion practice days, previews) on organizer sites before you go.

events.title: Midweek ramp — auctions & track week
events.summary: Trade-day energy: auction previews, track activity, and media events begin to stack.
events.description: Monday often marks the shift from casual weekend meets to structured midweek programming. If you care about auction lots, start tracking each house’s preview hours now.

events.title: Auction previews & hospitality days
events.summary: Public and credentialed auction viewing typically builds midweek — check each auctioneer.
events.description: Major houses (e.g. RM Sotheby’s, Gooding, Broad Arrow, Mecum and others in recent years) publish separate preview calendars. Bring ID; register early if bidding. Locations span Monterey hotels and conference facilities.

events.title: Pebble Beach Auctions (official calendar day)
events.summary: Official Pebble Beach Automotive Week calendar lists auctions on August 12, 2026 — confirm house and venue.
events.description: Auction week is a core midweek pillar. Viewing, registration, and sale sessions differ by house. Use official house sites for tickets and catalogs; this entry anchors the day so you can plan travel between Monterey and Pebble Beach.

events.title: McCall’s Motorworks Revival (typical timing)
events.summary: Evening aviation + exotic car gathering at the jet center — verify 2026 date and tickets.
events.description: A long-running Car Week staple pairing aircraft and automobiles. Tickets are limited and often sell early. Confirm the exact 2026 evening on the organizer’s site before locking plans.

events.title: Pebble Beach Tour d’Elegance
events.summary: Concours entrants drive a public scenic route — the best free chance to see them under power.
events.description: Official calendar date: August 13, 2026. Cars leave the Pebble Beach area and run coastal and peninsula roads (Highway 1, Carmel, Pacific Grove corridors in typical years). Roadside viewing is free. Arrive early for parking; stay clear of corners; do not block driveways or emergency access.
whatToLookFor: Cars at speed (safely from the curb)

events.title: Concours Village
events.summary: Exhibits, shopping, and displays around the Concours campus — free public access (confirm hours).
events.description: Official calendar lists Concours Village from August 13, 2026 (often multi-day through Concours weekend). Pair with Tour morning for a full Thursday. Exact booth list changes yearly.

events.title: Pebble Beach Classic Car Forum
events.summary: Talks and panels with collectors, designers, and historians.
events.description: Official calendar day: August 13, 2026. Indoor sessions add depth beyond the lawns. Session grid and tickets are published closer to the week on the Concours site.

events.title: Pebble Beach RetroAuto
events.summary: Automobilia market — literature, art, models, and collectibles.
events.description: Official calendar day: August 13, 2026. Ideal companion to the Forum. Access rules and multi-day hours can expand through the weekend — confirm on the official calendar.

events.title: Tour d’Elegance — Pacific Grove viewing
events.summary: Secondary roadside tip for Tour day along the Pacific Grove / coastal run.
events.description: If Carmel fills up, Pacific Grove corridors often still offer free curb views as Tour cars pass. Exact routing can change; follow day-of guidance and local traffic control.

events.title: The Quail, A Motorsports Gathering
events.summary: Garden-party motorsports concours in Carmel Valley — tickets are scarce.
events.description: One of Car Week’s most sought-after paid days: curated classes, manufacturer displays, and a relaxed lawn atmosphere. Plan transport early; parking and shuttles matter. Confirm 2026 gate times on the organizer site.

events.title: Concorso Italiano (typical Friday)
events.summary: Celebration of Italian marques — verify 2026 date, venue, and tickets.
events.description: Concorso Italiano is a Car Week institution for Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Alfa, and more. Venue has moved in past cycles; treat location as typical and confirm 2026 details before you go.

events.title: Concours Village — Friday
events.summary: Village activity continues into the weekend (confirm daily hours).
events.description: If Village is open multi-day in 2026, Friday is a good low-stress visit while Quail and Concorso absorb ticketed crowds elsewhere.

events.title: Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion — race day (typical)
events.summary: Historic racing at Laguna Seca — multi-day event; confirm 2026 schedule grid.
events.description: Period race cars on a legendary track. Reunion usually spans several days with practice, qualifying, and races. Buy tickets in advance; expect Highway 68 congestion.

events.title: Concours d’Lemons
events.summary: Anti-concours celebration of the odd and earnest — free spectator fun.
events.description: The humorous counterpoint to Concours Sunday. Expect character cars, handmade signs, and categories that reward story over polish. Location can shift; verify Seaside details for 2026.

events.title: Werks Reunion (Porsche — typical Saturday)
events.summary: Major Porsche gathering during Car Week — confirm 2026 venue and entry rules.
events.description: Werks Reunion draws huge air-cooled and modern Porsche crowds. Access for spectators vs registered cars differs; check the official Werks page for 2026.

events.title: Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion — Saturday
events.summary: Continued historic racing at Laguna Seca (confirm 2026 day schedule).
events.description: Saturday often carries strong race groups and bigger crowds. If you only pick one track day, verify which features are on the 2026 timetable.

events.title: Concours Village — Saturday
events.summary: Village bustle the day before Concours Sunday.
events.description: Good day to browse without Sunday ticket pressure. Confirm hours on the official calendar.

events.title: 75th Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance
events.summary: Flagship Concours on the 18th fairway — Best of Show caps Car Week.
events.description: Sunday, August 16, 2026. Show field opens early for credentialed spectators; classes are judged through the day; awards later afternoon. Tickets via the official Concours store. Dawn Patrol is a highlight if your credential allows. 2026 featured programming includes Lamborghini Miura 60th anniversary display among other classes — see official featured list.

events.title: Concours Village — Concours Sunday
events.summary: Village remains a free adjunct on Concours Sunday (confirm 2026 hours).
events.description: Useful if your Concours ticket is afternoon-only or you are meeting friends outside the ropes. Security and traffic are heaviest this day.

events.title: Pebble Beach RetroAuto — Sunday
events.summary: Automobilia continues for many visitors on Concours Sunday — confirm access.
events.description: If RetroAuto runs multi-day through Sunday in 2026, it is a calmer indoor option between fairway sessions. Check credentials vs general tickets.

events.title: Exotics on Broadway (typical)
events.summary: Evening exotic and supercar cruise culture as Car Week opens.
events.description: A recurring Car Week–week tradition of exotic cars downtown. Exact block parties and hours shift yearly — treat as a planning cue and confirm on See Monterey / local listings.

events.title: Hotel driveway meets
events.summary: Morning coffee + cars at major peninsula hotels as guests arrive.
events.description: Many visitors start Car Week with informal hotel lobby and driveway gatherings. No single organizer — wander Pebble Beach, Carmel, and Monterey properties with respect for guests and staff.

events.title: The Little Car Show (typical weekend)
events.summary: Small-displacement classics on Ocean Avenue — confirm 2026 date.
events.description: A beloved free Carmel show focused on cars under roughly 1600–2000cc historically. Date can land on different weekend days; verify 2026 listing before you go.

events.title: 17-Mile Drive scenic loop
events.summary: Drive or cycle the iconic peninsula road between events (toll / gate access).
events.description: Not a car show, but essential Car Week geography. Expect heavier traffic; budget gate fees and stop time at overlooks. Useful between satellite events.

events.title: Marque club corrals & parking meets
events.summary: Ferrari, Porsche, BMW, and more gather in club corrals across the peninsula.
events.description: Saturday is peak club culture. Some corrals are invitation-only; others welcome polite spectators. Check club socials for 2026 pins.

events.title: Concours week prep & media days
events.summary: Behind-the-scenes energy builds near Pebble Beach as midweek approaches.
events.description: Not a public ticketed show day, but a useful orientation day: learn gate logistics, shop Village if open early, and rest before auction week.

events.title: Carmel village car spotting
events.summary: Free walking circuit — Ocean Ave, side streets, and hotel drives.
events.description: Sunday afternoon car culture without a formal ticket. Be a good guest: sidewalks only, no blocking driveways.

events.title: Auction house load-in & early previews
events.summary: Houses begin staging lots; some offer early credentialed viewing.
events.description: Monday is when catalogs become real metal. Preview access varies — some free with registration, some ticketed. Confirm each auctioneer for 2026.

events.title: Laguna Seca — Reunion practice (typical)
events.summary: Historic race practice days often begin midweek at WeatherTech Raceway.
events.description: Exact 2026 Reunion schedule posts closer to the event. If practice is open to ticket holders, Monday–Tuesday can be less crowded than weekend race days.

events.title: RM Sotheby’s Monterey — preview (typical)
events.summary: Flagship catalog preview days for one of Car Week’s major auction houses.
events.description: RM Sotheby’s is a perennial Monterey fixture. Preview hours and sale nights are house-specific — use their 2026 event page for tickets and venue. Listed here as a midweek planning anchor.

events.title: Gooding & Company — preview (typical)
events.summary: Pebble Beach–area auction previews often run midweek near the Lodge.
events.description: Gooding traditionally anchors near Pebble Beach. Confirm 2026 pavilion location and sale night. Great complement to downtown previews the same day.

events.title: Broad Arrow / other houses — preview
events.summary: Additional auction previews fill midweek Monterey.
events.description: Multiple houses compete for attention. Use this slot to compare catalogs and plan which sale nights matter most to you.

events.title: Evening auction sales begin
events.summary: Sale sessions typically light up midweek evenings — check each house.
events.description: Wednesday is often when hammers start falling in earnest. Tickets, paddles, and dress codes vary. If you are not bidding, gallery seating may still require a pass.

events.title: Laguna Seca — qualifying / races (typical)
events.summary: Midweek track action as Reunion week builds.
events.description: Confirm 2026 Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion day schedule. Midweek tickets can be a calmer way to see historic cars on track.

events.title: Tour d’Elegance — early departure viewing
events.summary: Catch cars leaving the Pebble Beach campus at the start of Tour day.
events.description: If public viewing is available near staging, early morning is magical. Follow marshals; do not enter closed roads. Pair with Carmel or Pacific Grove curb spots later.

events.title: Auction sales continue
events.summary: Houses often continue previews and sales through Tour Thursday.
events.description: You can combine morning Tour roadside viewing with afternoon auction halls. Travel time between Carmel/Pebble and Monterey matters — plan buffers.

events.title: Legends of the Autobahn (typical timing)
events.summary: German marques gathering — confirm 2026 date and site.
events.description: BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Porsche, and friends often host a large midweek/weekend lawn. Access rules vary; check the Legends site for 2026.

events.title: Auction week peak sales
events.summary: Friday often hosts major sale sessions alongside Quail and Concorso.
events.description: If you only attend one auction night, verify which house features the lots you care about on Friday 2026.

events.title: Rolex Monterey Motorsports Reunion — feature Saturday
events.summary: Busy track day with strong historic grids (confirm 2026 feature races).
events.description: Saturday at Laguna Seca is a classic Car Week choice if you want racing over lawns. Buy tickets early; arrive before first green flag.

events.title: Concours field setup (restricted)
events.summary: Entrants and crews stage for Sunday — limited public access.
events.description: Not a general-admission show day. Included so you understand why Pebble Beach roads feel busy Saturday afternoon. Focus on Lemons, Werks, or Reunion instead unless you have credentials.

events.title: Private hospitality & brand evenings
events.summary: Invitation-only brand and collector dinners peak Saturday night.
events.description: Mostly not open to the public. Listed as context for why hotels and restaurants are fully booked. Enjoy public spots in Monterey and Carmel if you are freelancing.

events.title: Concours Dawn Patrol
events.summary: Early access for credentialed spectators as cars take the fairway.
events.description: One of the most atmospheric hours of Car Week. Confirm whether your 2026 ticket tier includes Dawn Patrol. Dress for fog and bring layers.

events.title: Concours awards & Best of Show
events.summary: Afternoon awards culminate in Best of Show on the fairway.
events.description: Exact award timing is announced on-site. Stay for the runway if your ticket allows — it is the emotional peak of the week.

events.title: Car Week departures & trailer traffic
events.summary: Expect heavy outbound traffic as the week ends.
events.description: Practical planning entry: book late dinners in Monterey, avoid rush-hour gates, and leave extra time for 17-Mile Drive exits.
